device: NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, aarch64, ROS 2 Jazzy, rmw_fastrtps_cpp, 8 online CPUs, schedutil
source: isolated localhost synthetic DDS streams, raw 1280x720 at 25 Hz unless encoded-only, identical valid JPEG and Annex-B H264 IDR fixtures; no live camera
method: Timed CPU percent from recorder process tree CPU ticks, normalized against one core; RSS sampled from /proc every 200 ms; per-topic readback against publish sequences, exact header times and payload bytes. Each sample uses an independent recorder process and fresh MCAP. All timed runs were uncompressed.
